title.narrative: Super Creators: Empowering Trusted Digital Voices with AI

description.narrative:
UNESCO and Google are partnering to develop a specialized Toolkit designed to empower digital content creators to become ethical and informed users of AI, strengthening their role as credible information intermediaries and contributing to more resilient online ecosystems. The Toolkit will integrate the AI frameworks and practical tools featured in Google’s Super Searchers program with UNESCO’s extensive Media and Information Literacy (MIL) expertise drawn from its online course for content creators, as well as the MILtiverse Toolkit for youth organizations.
To support the adoption of this Toolkit, UNESCO will conduct a series of workshops in Brazil, Indonesia, Kenya and Nigeria engaging local creator communities directly. In addition, targeted dissemination campaigns will be launched across Latin America and Francophone Africa to encourage broader uptake and integration of the Toolkit’s principles and resources.
The initiative’s official launch is planned for the African Creators Summit, to be held in Lagos in January 2026, providing a high-profile platform to showcase this collaboration and its commitment to nurturing ethical digital content creation. Furthermore, a dedicated session will be organized at RightsCon 2026 in Zambia to further promote the Toolkit, engage global stakeholders, and amplify the conversation around ethical AI use in digital content creation.
The initiative will contribute to implementing a part of the recommended actions aimed at digital content creators from the UNESCO’s Companion Document to the Guidelines for Governance of Digital Platforms, notably the Multistakeholder Action Plan for Integrating Media and Information Literacy on Digital Platforms.
